task.title: Restore the web-tainted durable-write security boundary
task.description: Recreate the 12-case security contract and reimplement durable-tool denial, session/SAC projections, normal/RLM wiki guards, and explicit security acknowledgement.

acceptance_criteria: After untrusted web output named durable tools are denied before invocation and read_file remains permitted.
Session archive/evidence, Slate, proposal record/note, normal and RLM wiki enrichment persist redacted content or no raw sentinel on block.
needs-approval requires explicit human security acknowledgement while binding/single-use/expiry and safe flow remain intact.
The dedicated 12-case test passes with an explicit 30000ms timeout, affected suites pass, and tsc passes.
constraints: Read the new worktree .metaproject/index.md first; use local testing/gdgraph/gdwiki/gdctx routing.
Use apply_patch; do not edit flow/docs/graph or architecture-owned files except session-wrap-up after the architecture agent finishes.
Before touching session-wrap-up, wait until 202-ARCH reports completion to the parent; meanwhile implement non-overlapping security files/tests.
Reuse prepareOutputForPersistence once available; preserve sync public APIs and fail closed on raw taint.
Use synthetic sentinels only; no full suite or commit; return STATUS first with exact results.
